notes: «فقال عبد الرحمن ولكن عمه» : Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla speaks inside the story, but his words are not the saying, so he is not a link
«مالك بن عامر أو مالك بن عوف» are alternatives in one level (rule 2); Malik answers Ibn Sirin, and Ibn Mas'ud's words are what he relays, so Ibn Mas'ud is the last link
«وقال أيوب عن محمد لقيت أبا عطية» names a different transmitter for the same report: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
